mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are 84 degrees with overcast skies at the Verona Public Library. It will be a rainy night with a low of 70 degrees. Also, keep your eyes on the sky at 4:24 AM for a space station flyover moving from the northwest to the southeast, passing almost directly overhead.

In city updates, a former teacher was arrested for an incident dating back to 2019. Also, road work on Highway M continues with new traffic patterns beginning the week of September 7, and the Military Ridge State Trail is preparing for a bridge replacement between Lincoln and South Franklin Street starting in mid-September.

We have a packed schedule! Enjoy live music at Bailey's Run today and at Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmer's Market or music at Paddy Mac's. Plus, mark your calendars for yoga on September 7 and trivia starting next week.
The Verona Police Department issued a release regarding an investigation into an inappropriate relationship that occurred on Sunday, August 31, 2026.
Today's flavor is the decadent Chocolate Volcano. The shop is open until 10:30 PM tonight, so stop by and treat yourself while you can.
